packet.headline_seed: Apple plans to make iOS 27 a Choose Your Own Adventure of AI models
packet.description_seed: With Apple's latest operating system updates, users will reportedly have their pick of which third-party AI models they want to use for a host of tasks.

what: Apple plans to make iOS 27 a Choose Your Own Adventure of AI models

clean_source_blocks.text: With Apple's latest operating system updates, users will reportedly have their pick of which third-party AI models they want to use for a host of tasks.

A new report from Bloomberg says that Apple plans to give users their pick of a number of third-party large language models that will be capable of powering various functions within the iPhone’s operating system. The new feature, dubbed “Extensions” internally, will allow users to “access generative AI capabilities from installed apps on demand, through Apple Intelligence features such as Siri, Writing Tools, Image Playground and more,” reads a message reportedly shown in test versions of the software.

Another enhancement will let users choose different voices for Siri conversations powered by external models. Queries handled by Apple’s own system could use one voice, while responses from third-party models — such as Anthropic’s Claude — could use another.

iOS 27 will give users a new way to integrate with third-party AI platforms, according to a new report. This will let iPhone users choose from multiple third-party models from companies like Google and Anthropic, including the ability to set custom voices in Siri depending on which external model is responding.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: TechCrunch]
When iOS 27 is released later this year, iPhone users will reportedly have a lot of choice when it comes to which AI models they want to use on-device.

A new report from Bloomberg says that Apple plans to give users their pick of a number of third-party large language models that will be capable of powering various functions within the iPhone’s operating system. The new feature, dubbed “Extensions” internally, will allow users to “access generative AI capabilities from installed apps on demand, through Apple Intelligence features such as Siri, Writing Tools, Image Playground and more,” reads a message reportedly shown in test versions of the software.

---

[Lähde: MacRumors]
iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27 will let users set third-party AI services as the default for Apple Intelligence features like Writing Tools and Image Playground, reports Bloomberg.

Apple has signed a deal with Google and plans to use a Gemini-based model for ‌Apple Intelligence‌ and Siri features in ‌iOS 27‌, but users will also be able to choose their favorite AI service as an alternative.

Apple has already partnered with OpenAI to make ChatGPT available in lieu of Apple's built-in options for ‌Siri‌, Writing Tools, and ‌Image Playground‌ on iOS 26, but in Apple's upcoming software updates, other third-party chatbots like Claude and Gemini will also be available. Instead of being limited to ChatGPT, users will select their preferred AI service.

Users can choose any AI provider that adds support for Apple's new ‌iOS 27‌, iPadOS 27, and ‌macOS 27‌ "Extensions" feature. From Bloomberg:

"Extensions allow you to access generative AI capabilities from installed apps on demand, through Apple Intelligence features such as Siri, Writing Tools, Image Playground and more," according to a message shown in test versions of the software.

Apple also plans to let users choose voices from third-party AI services for ‌Siri‌, which would make it clearer whether ‌Siri‌ or another AI product like Gemini is responding. ‌Siri‌ would use one voice, while responses from third-party AI options would use another voice.

Apple has many other AI-related changes planned for ‌iOS 27‌, with details available in our iOS 27 roundup.

---

[Lähde: 9to5Mac]
iOS 27 will give users a new way to integrate with third-party AI platforms, according to a new report. This will let iPhone users choose from multiple third-party models from companies like Google and Anthropic, including the ability to set custom voices in Siri depending on which external model is responding.

According to Blomberg, Apple is referring to this new capability as “Extensions” as part of iOS 27. In test versions of iOS 27, Apple explains that Extensions “allow you to access generative AI capabilities from installed apps on demand, through Apple Intelligence features such as Siri, Writing Tools, Image Playground and more.”

Apple Inc. will let users choose from a range of outside artificial intelligence services to power features across its software, building on a strategy to turn its devices into a comprehensive AI platform.

Users will be able to select from multiple third-party AI models for tasks like generating and editing text and images, according to people with knowledge of the matter. The change is slated for iOS 27, iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 this fall, said the people, who asked not to be identified because the plans are private.

Users will be able to choose from AI models that enable support through their App Store apps. For example, Google and Anthropic could add support for this Extensions system to the Gemini and Claude apps, respectively. Then, users could choose to use those models to power features like Siri, Writing Tools, and more.

This is in addition to Apple’s deal with Google to use Gemini to power native Siri and Apple Intelligence features. Today’s report also follows a Bloomberg report from March, which explained how the Extensions system will work with Siri itself. What’s new today is how the system will work with broader Apple Intelligence features beyond the voice assistant.

Apple added ChatGPT integration as part of iOS 18, using it as a fallback for world knowledge queries in Siri. ChatGPT is also accessible via things like Image Playground.

Speaking of Siri, today’s report also says that iOS 27 will let users choose different voices for each AI model:

Another enhancement will let users choose different voices for Siri conversations powered by external models. Queries handled by Apple’s own system could use one voice, while responses from third-party models — such as Anthropic’s Claude — could use another.

iOS 27 will be introduced at WWDC, which kicks off on June 8. What do you think of Apple’s plans for iOS

payload.title: Apple aikoo tuoda iOS 27:ään laajemman valinnan kolmansien osapuolten tekoälymalleista
payload.summary: Apple suunnittelee raporttien mukaan iOS 27:ään ominaisuutta, jonka avulla käyttäjät voisivat valita eri tehtäviin kolmansien osapuolten tekoälymalleja Applen omien järjestelmien rinnalle.
payload.content:
Apple aikoo raporttien mukaan laajentaa iPhonen tekoälytoimintoja iOS 27:ssä niin, että käyttäjät voisivat valita useista kolmansien osapuolten suurista kielimalleista eri tehtäviin. Suunnitelma liittyy Apple Intelligence -kokonaisuuteen ja voisi koskea esimerkiksi Siriä, kirjoitustyökaluja sekä kuvien luomiseen tarkoitettuja toimintoja.

## Tekoälymallit voisivat tulla käyttöön sovellusten kautta

Tietojen mukaan Apple kehittää sisäisesti “Extensions”-nimellä kutsuttua ominaisuutta, jonka ideana on antaa käyttäjille pääsy asennettujen sovellusten tarjoamiin generatiivisiin tekoälytoimintoihin tarpeen mukaan. Käytännössä tämä voisi tarkoittaa sitä, että iPhonen järjestelmätoiminnot eivät perustuisi vain Applen omaan tekoälyyn, vaan käyttäjä voisi valita tilanteeseen sopivan ulkoisen mallin.

Raportoidussa mallissa kolmansien osapuolten tekoäly voisi toimia osana tuttuja Apple Intelligence -toimintoja. Mainittuja käyttökohteita ovat muun muassa Siri, Writing Tools ja Image Playground. Tämä viittaa siihen, että Apple pyrkii tekemään ulkopuolisista tekoälypalveluista järjestelmätasolla helpommin käytettäviä sen sijaan, että ne jäisivät pelkästään yksittäisten sovellusten sisälle.

## Siriin voisi tulla eri ääniä eri malleille

Yksi suunniteltu lisäys koskisi Sirin ääniä. Käyttäjä voisi raporttien mukaan valita eri äänen sen mukaan, vastaako kyselyyn Applen oma järjestelmä vai ulkopuolinen tekoälymalli. Esimerkkeinä ulkopuolisista toimijoista on mainittu muun muassa Anthropic ja Google.

Tällainen ratkaisu tekisi käyttäjälle näkyvämmäksi sen, mikä tekoälymalli vastaa kulloinkin. Se voisi myös auttaa erottamaan Applen omat vastaukset kolmansien osapuolten mallien tuottamista vastauksista.

## Merkittävä muutos Applen tekoälystrategiaan

Jos ominaisuus toteutuu raportoidussa muodossa, iOS 27 merkitsisi Applen tekoälystrategiassa aiempaa avoimempaa suuntaa. Yhtiö on rakentanut Apple Intelligenceä vahvasti omien laitteidensa ja yksityisyyslupaustensa ympärille, mutta ulkoisten mallien laajempi valinta antaisi käyttäjille enemmän vaihtoehtoja.

Toistaiseksi kyse on raportoiduista suunnitelmista, eikä Apple ole vahvistanut kaikkia yksityiskohtia julkisesti. Siksi lopullinen toteutus, tuetut mallit ja saatavuus voivat vielä muuttua ennen iOS 27:n julkaisua.

Ominaisuus voisi toimia Apple Intelligence -toiminnoissa, kuten Sirissä, kirjoitustyökaluissa ja Image Playgroundissa.
Siriin saatetaan tuoda eri ääniä sen mukaan, vastaako Applen oma järjestelmä vai ulkoinen tekoälymalli.
